about: uv and a Python 3.12 with pip and venv, for a project's own dependencies: uv venv, then uv pip install -r requirements.txt. The node's own python3 has neither.
label: Python (uv)
name: python

run: dst="$2"; t="$(mktemp -d)"; mkdir -p "$dst/bin" "$dst/libexec"; tar -xzf "$1" -C "$t"; cp "$(find "$t" -name uv -type f | head -1)" "$dst/libexec/uv"; chmod +x "$dst/libexec/uv"; rm -rf "$dst/python"; export UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR="$dst/python" UV_CACHE_DIR="$t/cache" UV_NO_CONFIG=1; "$dst/libexec/uv" python install -q 3.12; py="$("$dst/libexec/uv" python find 3.12)"; ln -sf ../libexec/uv "$dst/bin/uv"; ln -sf "$(realpath --relative-to="$dst/bin" "$py")" "$dst/bin/python3.12"; rm -rf "$t"
